classification: qualitative uncontrolled observation plus idle health capture; not a scored accuracy trial

user_observation.false_alert_behavior: more alerts than the earlier useful-ten model including with quieter voices

diagnosis.primary_cause: The model has only five hazard outputs. Once ordinary speech passes the audio activity gate the closed-set softmax must distribute all probability among hazard classes.
diagnosis.secondary_cause: The decision filter was inherited from the earlier model and enters a class at 0.55 confidence without an explicit background or other output.
diagnosis.recommended_change: Retain five user-facing hazard alerts but train a sixth internal background_other output from diverse everyday sounds and speech; then calibrate per-class thresholds and the activity gate using hard-negative validation data.

interpretation: The microphone/DSP/NPU loop and LCD application are running normally. The quiet idle segment did not alert. The user's voice-triggered false alerts remain a valid qualitative hard-negative finding and motivate open-set rejection work.
